definitions.gloss: skin type; skin quality; skin texture
definitions.explanation: The natural characteristics and condition of a person's skin, such as whether it is oily, dry, sensitive, or combination. Widely used in skincare, cosmetics, and dermatology.

examples.japanese: ⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{肌質|はだしつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{知|し}る→知る：00458_shiru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧だ。
examples.english: It's important to know your own skin type.

examples.japanese: {肌質|はだしつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{合|あ}った→合う：10466_au⟧⟦{化粧水|けしょうすい}→化粧水：15802_keshousui⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}んで→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please choose a toner that suits your skin type.

examples.japanese: ⟦{季節|きせつ}の{変|か}わり{目|め}→季節の変わり目：22134_kisetsunokawarime⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{肌質|はだしつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{変化|へんか}→変化：03615_henka⟧しやすい⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦スキンケア→スキンケア：23083_sukinkea⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見直|みなお}す→見直す：04579_minaosu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧よい。
examples.english: Skin type tends to change at the turn of the seasons, so it's good to reconsider your skincare routine.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{肌|はだ}→肌：02243_hada⟧ (skin) and ⟦{質|しつ}→質：01425_shitsu⟧ (quality, nature). A core term in the Japanese beauty and skincare industry, which is one of the largest in the world. Understanding this word is essential for shopping for cosmetics or visiting a dermatologist in Japan.

COMMON SKIN TYPES:
- ⟦{乾燥肌|かんそうはだ}→乾燥肌：16609_kansouhada⟧: dry skin
- ⟦{脂性肌|しせいはだ}→脂性肌：23960_shiseihada⟧: oily skin
- ⟦{混合肌|こんごうはだ}→混合肌：23961_kongouhada⟧: combination skin
- ⟦{敏感肌|びんかんはだ}→敏感肌：19065_binkanhada⟧: sensitive skin
- {普通肌|ふつうはだ}: normal skin

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {肌質|はだしつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{合|あ}う→合う：10466_au⟧: to suit one's skin type
- {肌質|はだしつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{改善|かいぜん}する→改善する：26828_kaizensuru⟧: to improve skin quality
- {肌質|はだしつ}⟦{診断|しんだん}→診断：04209_shindan⟧: skin type analysis
- {肌質|はだしつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{変|か}わる→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧: skin type changes

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{肌|はだ}→肌：02243_hada⟧: skin — the body part itself
- ⟦{肌触|はだざわ}り→肌触り：06637_hadazawari⟧: texture, feel (of skin or fabric) — how something feels to the touch
- ⟦{体質|たいしつ}→体質：08243_taishitsu⟧: constitution, physical makeup — broader term for overall body type
